trickyParts: Open-fence rule is the parser's: when the body's last leaf block is a mermaid code block, the body is parsed again with a probe line (U+2063-wrapped) after it, inside the last line's quote/list containers and with no blank line before it; the fence is open exactly when the probe lands inside that mermaid code block. A bare blank line + probe would end an open fence's quote or list item and read a streamed quoted diagram as closed.
drawMermaidDiagrams takes a reparse function; useRenderedMarkdown passes (source) => engine.parse(source, softBreaks), so the probe parse uses the same engine and soft-break policy as the body.
